notes: DECIDED 2026-08-25: local SPM package. Stacks/Content plus pure-logic Services become Packages/SwiftReadability, tested via swift test on macOS with no simulator. Rationale: makes the gate seconds-long and parallel-safe across worktrees, and turns the Q2 SwiftReadability extraction from aspiration into fact. Cost is one refactor: file moves, public access control, project.yml package dependency.
